sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Friend Among Strangers is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "You've made a name for yourself, and I may have an assignment for someone like you. But before I do, I want to make sure you can tell who's an asset and who's a threat. It's simple, shoot the PMCs, but don't hurt my people. Understood?"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 7 PMC operatives without killing Scavs, Scav Raiders, Rogues or Bosses

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +25,600 EXP
- Fence Rep +0.04
- 1,200 Euros
  - 1,260 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 1,380 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 2× Military flash drive
"Here's your reward."

sections.heading: Failure Dialogue
sections.text: "Doesn't seem like you're trying to keep my people safe. Turns out you're more of a liability than a benefit. If you want to work with me, you have to prove your worth."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
In this quest you have to kill 7 PMCs without killing any Scavs, Scav Raiders, Rogues or Bosses.

Note: Even after killing all PMCs, killing any of the above before you have left the raid and turned in the quest will result in a failure. You may die by any means and still complete the quest.
